paired.contract: G6 reports a PAIR, from the SAME --seeds N run: WHOLE-DESIGN worst-of-N (the PROMOTION gate, unchanged in role -- E3/E4/E5 score it and the board must satisfy it) and CORE-DOMAIN worst-of-N (what a downstream integration inherits).  Each is quoted with its BINDING CONE and its k.  NEITHER STANDS IN FOR THE OTHER, and the core-domain figure is NOT a gate: no bar reads it.

core_domain.definition: min over SAME, INTO, OUTOF -- the three SDC classes whose BOTH endpoints are v30u_eu/v30u_biu registers

whole_design.source: Quartus's own Fmax Summary (E3), per draw

core_domain.caveat: UPPER BOUND: each class row is the worst path in that collection BY SLACK, not by slack/k, so a row can return a path carrying a different exception than its label names.  `off_class` lists the rows where the measured k and the label's k disagree ON THIS DRAW.
